title: vec orphan-list response (v1.0.69)
description: Response shape of `sqlite-graphrag vec orphan-list --json`. Added in v1.0.69 as part of G39. Corrected by GAP-SG-271, which ran the command and validated the real envelope for the first time: the document declared `namespace` and an `orphans` array of `{vector_hash, kind}`, neither of which `VecOrphanListResponse` in src/commands/vec.rs has ever serialized, and omitted the `action` and `items` members it always emits. Under `additionalProperties: false` that rejected every real answer. The scan reads only the active memory embedding table, so no `kind` discriminator exists.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope. Otherwise the number of elements in `items`.

items.description: Orphan rows of the active memory embedding table, i.e. rows whose parent memory is missing or soft-deleted. Empty when no embedding table exists yet.

memory_id.description: The `memory_id` recorded on the orphan row; the memory it points at is gone or soft-deleted

vector_hash.description: Hex-encoded BLAKE3 hash of the embedding blob, which fingerprints duplicate vectors across re-embeddings

created_at.description: Unix timestamp of the row insertion, read as an INTEGER
